WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.label: Absolute Solver
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.description: The foundational core of all Solver abilities, this trait marks the bearer as a true Solver—capable of bending reality, rewriting matter, and shaping the world with forbidden technology. The first step on a path of limitless potential... and unimaginable consequences.
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.tooltipExtra: The core trait of a Solver, granting the ability to manipulate reality and unlock advanced technologies. Essential for accessing all Solver abilities.
